visualCharacteristics: A list of news items, each with a date and a linked title with an arrow, under a heading and followed by more-links buttons. Variants show a notice box with an alert icon or a grid of recommended image cards.
contentPattern: Row 1: [heading]. One row per item: [date paragraph] [title link paragraph]. Last row: [more link paragraphs]. Notice variant: [title paragraph] then one [link paragraph] per notice. Recommended variant: [heading] then one row per card: [picture] [caption link paragraph].
usage: Use it for dated news, announcements or important notices.
reuseGuidance: Reuse it for any dated list of announcement links; pick cards for image-led content without dates.
